messages.text:
"A game where you play as a polar bear, with the goal of finding other polar bears—each one unique. You must dance to convince these other polar bears to join your team, and together you will battle against brown bears, who serve as your enemies. Combat takes the form of dancing, where each distinct dance move functions as a different attack, complete with special salmon-themed visual effects. As you defeat brown bears, you level up, gaining access to special abilities and unique, equipable items. The game world is a polar island featuring a variety of distinct biomes and enemies.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.
"
